children.name: Content-Type
children.description: 默认值：application/json

children.name: x-lt-openKeyId
children.description: 访问用户隐私数据时的唯一权限标识 openKeyId

children.name: x-lt-timestamp
children.description: 请求时间戳，格式为时间转换为毫秒的值，也就是从1970年1月1日起至今的时间转换为毫秒，如：1583398764000

children.name: x-lt-signature
children.description: 接口签名

children.name: x-lt-language
children.description: 指定出参语种，默认中文。支持语种，英语：US，法语：FR，西班牙语：ES，德语：DE，中文简体：CN，泰语：TH，巴西葡语：PT，土耳其语：TR

children.name: orderNo
children.description: 采购单号
children.label: 订单号

children.name: supplierSku
children.description: 卖家sku编码和sheinSku必填其中一项，推荐使用sheinSku

children.name: printNumber
children.description: 数组此字段累计打印份数不能超过2000个；定制急采单的场景使用急采单的下单数入参；
children.label: 打印份数

children.name: sheinSku
children.description: sheinSku即sku_code，sku_code是商品发布SHEIN生成的系统编码

children.name: printContentType
children.description: 指定条码展示内容（默认打印商家货号）；1:商家货号/ 2:商家sku编码

children.name: printFormatType
children.description: 指定条码打印大小（仅巴西商家适用，非巴西商家默认打印20*70）；1:打印20*70/ 2:打印25*40

children.name: code
children.description: code=0成功，code =1失败；失败时失败信息在msg字段，如果errorData不为空,说明存在不符合打印的条件, 报错明细需重新核对
children.label: 返回码

children.name: url
children.description: 商品条码的url，如果errorData不为空，则字段为空，打印内容支持指定语种出参；
children.label: PDF下载链接

children.name: errorData
children.description: 错误信息
children.label: 错误内容明细

children.name: orderNo
children.description: 入参的订单号
children.label: 订单号

children.name: supplierSku
children.description: 卖家sku编码
children.label: 商品sku

children.name: errorMsg
children.description: 错误提示明细；支持指定语种出参；
children.label: 错误内容

children.name: printNumber
children.description: 入参的打印份数，此字段累计打印份数不能超过2000个
children.label: 打印份数

children.name: sheinSku
children.description: sheinSku即sku_code，sku_code是商品发布SHEIN生成的系统编码
children.label: sheinSku

children.name: codingInfoList
children.description: 查询成功返回编码信息
children.label: 编码信息

children.name: orderNo
children.description: 订单号
children.label: 订单号

children.name: supplierSku
children.description: 卖家sku编码
children.label: 卖家sku编码

children.name: sheinSku
children.description: sheinSku即sku_code，sku_code是商品发布SHEIN生成的系统编码
children.label: SHEIN sku code

children.name: barcode
children.description: barcode条码；定制商品无需关注
children.label: barcode条码

children.name: customCodingList
children.description: 定制商品二维码编码值

children.name: traceId
children.description: 请求的唯一标识；用于异常报错跟踪

requestExample: curl --location --request POST 'https://openapi-test01.sheincorp.cn/open-api/goods/print-barcode' \ --header 'language: zh-cn' \ --header 'x-lt-openKeyId: <OFFICIAL_EXAMPLE_OPEN_KEY_ID>' \ --header 'x-lt-signature: <OFFICIAL_EXAMPLE_SIGNATURE>' \ --header 'x-lt-timestamp: 1752733538805' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'Host: openapi-test01.sheincorp.cn' \ --data-raw '{ "type": 2, "data": [ { "orderNo": null, "supplierSku": null, "printNumber": 1, "sheinSku": "I94higsnyh7g" } ] }'
